reference.script: const fs=require('fs'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),{chromium}=require('playwright');(async()=>{const b=await chromium.launch({executablePath:'/usr/bin/chromium',args:['--no-sandbox']}),p=await b.newPage({viewport:{width:1280,height:853},reducedMotion:'reduce'}),records=[];await p.goto(process.env.ROOT+'/lol-coach/loading.html');await p.locator('#analyze:enabled').waitFor();await p.locator('#example-0').click();for(const [own,pos]of[['Caitlyn','BOTTOM'],['Ahri','MID']]){await p.locator('#input-panel').evaluate(e=>e.open=true);await p.locator('#own-champion').selectOption(own);await p.locator('#own-position').selectOption(pos);await p.locator('#analyze').click();await p.locator('.plan-master').waitFor();await p.screenshot({path:process.env.OUT+'/reference-'+own+'-1280-base.png'});const overview=await p.locator('.plan-master').innerText();await p.locator('[data-plan-area=lane]').click();assert(await p.locator('.plan-master').isHidden());await p.screenshot({path:process.env.OUT+'/reference-'+own+'-1280-detail.png'});records.push({own,overview,detail:await p.locator('.plan-detail').innerText(),url:p.url()});await p.locator('[data-coach-focus=close-detail]').click();await p.locator('.plan-detail').waitFor({state:'hidden'});}fs.writeFileSync(process.env.OUT+'/reference-output.json',JSON.stringify(records,null,2));await b.close();})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)});
